entries.title: Contact Form Information
entries.answer: The contact form collects first name, last name, email, phone number, company name, position, and message. For faster routing, users should describe the product, site problem, urgency, and how they prefer to be contacted.

entries.title: Chatbot RFQ Information
entries.answer: For chatbot RFQs, the assistant collects the product or system needed, application or site problem, quantity or capacity, location, urgency, name, phone, email, and company. Product, name, and phone are required so the Vortexus team can follow up.

entries.title: Operations and Locations
entries.answer: The website presents Vortexus operations and service presence through listed office or service locations, including Nairobi areas such as Dar Es Salaam Road and Cabanas on Mombasa Road, plus Mombasa support. Customers can use the contact page for direct enquiries.
